Turkey Meatballs in Tomato Sauce

Mix 500 g minced turkey, 1 egg, 40 g breadcrumbs, 2 grated garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Sauce: 1 jar passata, 1 tbsp olive oil, basil.

1. Wet your hands and roll the mixture into 20 balls.
2. Brown them in a pan with a little oil for 5 minutes.
3. Pour in the passata and add some basil.
4. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, turning once.
5. Serve over spaghetti or in a bun.

Security tip of the week from Harlow & Finch IT: if an email creates urgency, slow down. Messages claiming your mailbox is "about to be deleted" or your payroll is "on hold" are almost always phishing. Never click the link in such a message, and never type your password into a page you reached from an email. Instead, open your browser, go to the intranet yourself and check there. If you are still unsure, forward the message to the Security Desk using the Report Phish button and then delete it from your inbox.

Solo Sailor Breaks Atlantic Crossing Record

French sailor Camille Roche crossed the Atlantic singlehanded in 5 days, 14 hours and 8 minutes, beating the previous monohull record by almost eleven hours, organisers confirmed on Sunday.

Roche, 36, set off from New York and arrived at the Lizard, Cornwall, on a 60-foot racing boat. She said strong westerly winds and "very little sleep" were the keys.

"It was cold, wet and exhilarating," she said at the dock, wrapped in a blanket. Race officials will validate her data over the coming weeks.

Most Employees Want to Keep Hybrid Working, Survey Finds

Nearly three in four office workers in Central Europe want to keep working from home at least two days a week, according to a survey of 6,000 employees by recruitment firm Talentis.

Employers were more cautious: 38% of companies said they planned to increase office days next year. Workers who commute more than an hour a day were the most likely to resist.

Researchers said that productivity effects remain debated, with some studies showing gains and others reporting slower collaboration. Flexible policies were rated a top factor when choosing a job.

Greek Salad

Ingredients: 4 tomatoes, 1 cucumber, 1 red onion, 1 green pepper, 150 g feta, 12 Kalamata olives, 4 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, dried oregano.

1. Cut the tomatoes into wedges and the cucumber into thick slices.
2. Slice the onion and pepper into thin rings.
3. Combine in a bowl with the olives.
4. Whisk the oil and vinegar and pour it over.
5. Lay the feta block on top and sprinkle with oregano.

1. Pour the wet mixture into the dry and stir until just combined; leave lumps.

4. Spray de-icer along the edges if the wipers are stuck.

Galuskaleves (Semolina Dumpling Soup)

Ingredients: 1.2 litres chicken or vegetable stock, 1 egg, 60 g semolina, 1 tbsp soft butter, pinch of salt, parsley.

1. Beat the butter and egg together in a bowl.
2. Stir in the semolina and salt, then rest the mixture for 15 minutes.
3. Bring the stock to a simmer.
4. Using two wet teaspoons, shape small dumplings and drop them in.
5. Cook for 10 minutes until they float and are puffy. Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

Galuskaleves (Semolina Dumpling Soup)

Ingredients: 1.2 litres chicken or vegetable stock, 1 egg, 60 g semolina, 1 tbsp soft butter, pinch of salt, parsley.

1. Beat the butter and egg together in a bowl.
2. Stir in the semolina and salt, then rest the mixture for 15 minutes.
3. Bring the stock to a simmer.
4. Using two wet teaspoons, shape small dumplings and drop them in.
5. Cook for 10 minutes until they float and are puffy. Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

Investigating slow queries on the reporting database

Connect with SSMS and run:

```
SELECT TOP 10 total_elapsed_time/execution_count AS avg_ms, text
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(sql_handle)
ORDER BY avg_ms DESC;
```

Look for missing indexes in the execution plan. Update statistics with `UPDATE STATISTICS dbo.Orders WITH FULLSCAN` during off-hours only.

The "parallelism wait" entries in the monitor are expected during month-end close and shouldn't be treated as faults.

Poppy Seed Beigli: A Christmas Classic

Beigli, the rolled sweet bread filled with poppy seeds or walnuts, is a staple of the Hungarian holiday table. This version makes two rolls.

Dough: 500 g flour, 250 g butter, 200 ml milk, 40 g sugar, 25 g yeast, 1 egg.
Filling: 250 g ground poppy seeds, 120 g sugar, 150 ml milk, 1 tbsp honey, lemon zest.

Prepare the dough and let it rest for an hour. Roll into rectangles, spread with filling, roll up tightly and brush with egg yolk. Bake at 180 degrees Celsius for 40 minutes. The classic marbled crust appears if you chill the rolls before baking.

Lamb and Apricot Tagine

Ingredients: 700 g lamb shoulder, 2 onions, 150 g dried apricots, 2 tsp ras el hanout, 1 cinnamon stick, 400 ml stock, 2 tbsp olive oil, toasted almonds, coriander.

Method:
1. Brown the lamb in oil in an ovenproof pot.
2. Add onions and spices; cook for 5 minutes.
3. Pour in stock and add the apricots.
4. Cover and cook at 160 °C for 2 hours.
5. Scatter with almonds and coriander and serve with couscous.

Planting Garlic in October: A Simple Guide

Garlic planted in autumn develops stronger roots and gives larger bulbs the following July. Choose a sunny spot with well-drained soil and dig in a little compost beforehand.

Separate the bulbs into individual cloves, keeping the papery skin on. Plant each clove pointed end up, about 5 cm deep and 15 cm apart, in rows 25 cm apart. Water once and then leave them be; frost will not harm them.

Mulch with straw to suppress weeds. In spring, remove any flower stems (scapes) so the plant puts its energy into the bulb. Harvest when the lower leaves turn brown.

1. Preheat the oven to 200 °C.

3. Cut the baguette diagonally into thick slices without cutting through the bottom crust.

Freelance Services Agreement: What to Include

A good freelance contract protects both sides. At a minimum, it should name the parties, describe the work in detail and set out the fee and payment schedule.

Other clauses worth adding:
- Revisions: how many rounds are included in the price
- Intellectual property: when ownership passes to the client
- Termination: notice period and payment for work already done
- Confidentiality and data protection obligations
- Late payment interest

3. Lower the heat. Place the miso in a ladle and dissolve it into the soup by stirring with a spoon.
4. Do not boil the soup after adding miso.

5. Log the battery date on the unit's sticker and in the asset register.

Low disk space alert on app-srv-11 (root volume above 92%)

1. Log in and run `df -h` to confirm which mount is full.
2. Find the biggest directories: `du -xh / --max-depth=2 | sort -rh | head -20`.
3. Journal logs are often the cause. Run `journalctl --vacuum-time=7d`.
4. Remove rotated logs in /var/log/app/ older than 30 days.
5. Never delete anything under /var/lib/docker by hand; use `docker system prune` after checking with the platform team.

The "inode usage 12%" line in the alert is informational only.

Keep fresh herbs alive for two weeks

Trim the stems of soft herbs like parsley and coriander and stand them in a glass with an inch of water, like flowers. Loosely cover the leaves with a plastic bag and place it in the fridge, changing the water every couple of days. For basil, do the same but leave it on the counter, since the cold turns the leaves black. Beloved Family Bakery to Close After 61 Years

KECSKEMÉT - Pékség Domonkos, a fixture on Rákóczi út since 1965, will close its doors on 31 December, owner Ferenc Domonkos announced this week.

Domonkos, 68, said rising energy costs and the lack of a successor had made the decision unavoidable. "My children have other careers, and I cannot bake forever," he said. The shop's walnut rolls and morning pogácsa have been local favourites for generations.

Customers have been leaving notes of thanks on the counter. A farewell weekend with free tastings is planned for 19 and 20 December.

Hand-wash a wool jumper

1. Turn the jumper inside out and check the care label.
2. Fill a basin with lukewarm water and add a capful of wool detergent.
3. Submerge the jumper and squeeze it gently for two minutes. Don't wring.
4. Drain the basin and rinse in clean lukewarm water.
5. Press the water out against the side, then roll the jumper in a thick towel.
6. Reshape it flat on a drying rack, away from radiators.

Ingredients: 400 g minced beef, 200 g minced pork, 1 onion, 1 carrot, 1 celery stick, 3 tbsp tomato puree, 200 ml red wine, 400 ml milk, 1 can tomatoes, bay leaf, olive oil.

1. Finely chop the vegetables and fry them in oil until soft.
2. Brown the meats in batches and add to the pot.
3. Stir in puree and wine and let it bubble down.
4. Add milk, tomatoes and bay leaf.
5. Simmer very gently for 2.5 hours, stirring occasionally.

Choose a shady, well-drained corner and place a bin or wooden pallet frame there. Lay twigs on the bottom for airflow. Add layers of "greens" such as vegetable peelings and grass clippings, alternating with "browns" such as torn cardboard, dry leaves and straw. Sprinkle a handful of garden soil between layers. Start with `kubectl -n payments get pods` and note the restart count. Then run `kubectl -n payments logs <pod> --previous` to read the last crash output.

You can ignore the "FailedScheduling" event if it appears only once and the pod starts within two minutes. Do not delete the deployment; scale to zero and back instead.

- Start the donor car and wait three minutes, then start the other car.
- Remove the clamps in reverse order.

Changing a flat tyre

1. Park on level ground, switch on the hazard lights, and apply the handbrake.
2. Take the spare wheel, jack and wrench from the boot.
3. Loosen the wheel nuts a half turn while the car is still on the ground.
4. Place the jack under the marked jacking point and raise the car until the wheel clears the ground.
5. Remove the nuts, pull the wheel off, and mount the spare.
6. Tighten the nuts by hand, lower the car, then tighten them in a star pattern.
7. Check the spare's pressure at the next petrol station.

Easy Banana Bread

You need: 3 very ripe bananas, 75 g melted butter, 150 g sugar, 1 egg, 1 tsp vanilla, 1 tsp baking soda, pinch of salt, 190 g flour.

1. Heat the oven to 175 °C and grease a loaf tin.
2. Mash the bananas in a bowl and mix in the butter.
3. Stir in sugar, egg and vanilla.
4. Sprinkle over baking soda and salt, then fold in the flour.
5. Pour into the tin and bake for 55 minutes.
6. Cool in the tin for 10 minutes before slicing.

Replacing a failed access switch (24-port PoE, model AX-24P)

1. Take a photo of the cabling on the old switch and label each cable by port number.

5. Verify phones have power and registered.

The STP topology change notice after step 4 is normal. Record the old serial in the asset register for return.

Understanding Your Fixed-Rate Electricity Tariff

A fixed-rate tariff locks the price per kilowatt-hour for the length of your contract, usually 12 or 24 months. Your standing charge stays the same too, so your bill changes only when you use more or less energy.

Things to check before you sign:
- Early exit fees, which can be as much as 60 EUR per fuel
- Whether the rate includes network charges
- The date your contract ends and when your supplier must notify you

If wholesale prices fall, you will not benefit until the contract ends. Many households still prefer the certainty, especially in winter.

Honey-Soy Chicken Wings

Ingredients: 1 kg chicken wings, 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp grated ginger, sesame seeds, 2 spring onions.

1. Heat the oven to 210 °C and line a tray with baking paper.
2. Pat the wings dry and bake for 25 minutes.
3. Meanwhile, simmer honey, soy, vinegar, garlic and ginger in a small pan for 4 minutes.
4. Toss the wings in the glaze and return them to the oven for 10 minutes.
5. Scatter with sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.

Cheese Pogácsa (makes about 24)

Ingredients: 500 g flour, 250 g butter, 200 g grated cheese, 200 g sour cream, 1 egg yolk, 1 tsp salt, 7 g yeast.

1. Rub the butter into the flour and salt, then stir in the yeast.
2. Add the sour cream and half of the cheese and knead briefly.
3. Roll to 2 cm thick, fold into thirds and chill for 30 minutes. Repeat twice.
4. Cut into rounds, score the tops and brush with yolk.
5. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.

Juice of 1 lime

Volunteers Restore 18th-Century Mill in Őrség

Astronomers Find Rocky Planet in Habitable Zone of Nearby Star

An international team has identified a rocky planet roughly 1.3 times the size of Earth orbiting a red dwarf 38 light years away, according to a paper published this week.

The planet, named Wolf-Kessler b, completes an orbit every 21 days and sits within the zone where liquid water could exist. Lead author Dr. Yusuf Demir of the Istanbul Observatory said follow-up observations with a space telescope are planned for next year to look for an atmosphere.

"It is far too early to speak of life," Demir cautioned. "But it is a very promising target."

You need 100 g pudding rice, 750 ml whole milk, 3 tbsp sugar, 1 vanilla pod (or 1 tsp extract), a strip of lemon peel and cinnamon for dusting.

4. Remove the peel and pod.
5. Spoon into bowls and dust with cinnamon.

Sew a button back on

1. Thread a needle with about 50 cm of thread and knot the end.
2. Push the needle up through the fabric from the back at the mark where the button was.
3. Slide the button onto the needle and lay a matchstick across the top.
4. Sew down through the other hole, then up again, around five times.
5. Remove the matchstick and wind the thread around the stitches under the button.
6. Push the needle to the back, tie off and snip the thread.
